## About
Asian One is a car repair shop on Cobb Parkway in Marietta. We specialize in Lexus, Toyota, Honda and Acura, and we also work on European and domestic vehicles. Along with repairs and major services, we handle body work and emissions.
Hung Lam and the team believe in personalized attention to each customer. That means walking you through the problem, telling you why a repair is needed and not just what, and keeping the price fair.
Drivers around Marietta have given us a 4.6 rating across 92 Google reviews. Several mention coming to us after other quotes seemed too high, and staying because they found a shop they could trust.

## Services
- Major services: Scheduled maintenance services for your vehicle, done at the shop.
- Repair service: Quality repair work at a fair price, from A/C and coolant leaks to fuel pumps and filters.
- Body shop: Body work handled in the same shop as your mechanical repairs.
- Emissions: Emissions service at our Cobb Parkway location.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Lexus, Toyota, Honda and Acura, and we also work on European and domestic vehicles.
